# Blewett

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P13](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P19](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mrs. [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) is a small woman with a shrewish face. She has a very lean build, lacking any superfluous flesh on her bones.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)_

## Personality

Blewett is characterized by a shrewish demeanor, a fearsome temper, and pronounced stinginess. Servants previously in her employ have attested to her harsh nature and parsimonious habits.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)_

## Traits

- presumed shrewish and stingy with a fearsome temper  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)</sub>

## History

Blewett arrived at Mrs. Spencer's home while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) were clarifying the mix-up regarding the orphan boy [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) had originally requested. Seeing an opportunity, Blewett offered to take [Anne](../character/anne.md) into her own household to work as a servant. However, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitated to hand [Anne](../character/anne.md) over after witnessing the girl's distress in Blewett's presence, ultimately choosing to take [Anne](../character/anne.md) back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P1](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P2](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P5](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P11](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P16](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0016), +9 more_
